title: vulpia membranacea subsp. fasciculata
intro: Vulpia membranacea subsp. fasciculata, commonly known as Purple Fescue, is a perennial grass species native to the mountainous regions of the western United States and Canada. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Purple Fescue are attributed to its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
